description: Use for 'a two-day food itinerary for <city>' or 'how to spend 48 hours eating in <city>'. Editorial day-by-day food itineraries for a city (read-only): every venue resolved to an id, address, hours and page URL. Empty list when the city has none.

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. 'new-york-city' or 'New York City'. Unknown cities answer with did_you_mean.
city.title: City

country.description: Country slug or name, e.g. 'italy'. Optional where city is given.
country.title: Country

name: itineraries
title: Editorial food itineraries
